create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter instance to track the running average of values over time
add_to_average_meter: add a value with an optional count to an AverageMeter and retrieve the current average
reset_average_meter: reset an AverageMeter to clear its accumulated sum and count back to zero
create_accuracy_meter: create an AccuracyMeter to measure top-k accuracy for multi-class classification predictions
add_to_accuracy_meter: add model output and ground truth labels to an AccuracyMeter and retrieve top-k accuracy results
